stylePrefix: Educational phrasal verb flashcard illustration in the same art style as the reference: modern soft digital illustration, comic-book lite, friendly and approachable. Thin dark slightly soft outlines, vibrant but slightly muted harmonious colors, soft gradients and gentle cel-shading, subtle warm paper texture in the background. Simplified expressive human characters with clear body language, minimal uncluttered background with only props needed for the action. Centered composition, square 1:1. Pure illustration only: NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO phonetics, NO translations, NO borders, NO colored header bars, NO numbered badges, NO UI chrome, NO watermarks.

items.scene: Young woman notices a subtle hint: man beside her makes a small pointing gesture toward something hidden; she has a thoughtful realizing expression, lightbulb moment. Simple indoor cafe background.

Person giving in to temptation, reaching for a slice of frosted cake on a plate while looking guilty but unable to resist. Simple kitchen table background.
Happy person with suitcase and sun hat gazing excitedly toward a sunny beach horizon through a window or open door, dreaming of upcoming trip. Warm hopeful mood.
Person breaking free from a chain and walking away from a group of identical gray figures behind them, determined independent expression. Simple path background.
Friendly manager opening office door and welcoming several new clients inside, handshakes, positive business growth mood. Simple modern office entryway.

MEMORABLE HOOK: Person straining both arms to hold back an enormous glossy smartphone sliding toward them like a wild animal on a leash, resisting temptation, exaggerated frustrated desire expression. Funny and instantly recognizable delay impulse.

MEMORABLE HOOK: In dusty attic, person kneeling and suddenly discovering a glowing vintage diary under loose floorboards, golden dust motes in sunbeam, shocked delighted face, hands frozen mid-reach. Strong surprise discovery moment.

MEMORABLE HOOK: Young man snapping a bright colorful friendship bracelet chain in half while turning his back and walking away from three friends reaching out behind him, decisive fresh-start expression. Clear visual of ending ties.

MEMORABLE HOOK: Confident woman on small stage building a visible rainbow bridge from her open palms to three listeners, simple glowing lightbulb icons traveling across bridge into their minds, everyone nodding with understanding. Clear communicate idea metaphor.

MEMORABLE HOOK: Progression visual: same woman shown running short distance then medium then full marathon finish line, training steps getting bigger, triumphant at end.
